class_teacher_id.description: Teacher ID of the class teacher

subject_teacher_map.description: Mapping of subject ID to assigned teacher ID

language_block_enabled.description: Whether language block synchronization is enabled for this section. When enabled, language periods for the same tier are scheduled simultaneously across all sections in the same grade.

language_tier_config.description: Configuration for each language tier. Maps tier number (1, 2, 3) to the language subject IDs available for this section. Example: {'2': ['KANNADA', 'SANSKRIT'], '3': ['HINDI', 'FRENCH']}

language_subjects.description: DEPRECATED: Use language_tier_config instead. List of language subject IDs for language block

language_teachers.description: DEPRECATED: Derived automatically from subject_teacher_map for language subjects. List of teacher IDs for language block synchronization
